scope: Diagnostic inspection in an existing user-operated Proxmox VM after the persistent DNS repair, including a temporary EEPROM export that was removed. No registration requests, account changes or cloud configuration changes were performed by the diagnostic.

guest_observations.guest_access: Already authenticated root serial console via authorized Proxmox host
guest_observations.reason: Unable to generate deviceId based on eeprom. Invalid eeprom.

core_registration_sequence: Bind an existing local owner to the supplied UI account through the normal authenticated registration API
Run ubnt-tools id with an output file and read its bytes
POST hardwareId from board.uuid, ownerId and base64 of the exported EEPROM to cloud /register
Receive connection settings and MQTT client credentials only after successful registration
original_firmware_analysis.udmea4c_export_format: Exact copy of the complete 65536-byte EEPROM, without a new envelope, encryption or recomputed checksum
original_firmware_analysis.virtual_identity_origin: Locally generated public board metadata; manufacturer credential regions remain absent

conclusion: The cloud rejects the current synthetic EEPROM. No demonstrated transport, serialization or local CRC defect explains this rejection, and no verified repair is currently available.
limits: The cloud error does not disclose whether a field, format, signature or other validation fails.
A mandatory cryptographic attestation or secure-element requirement is not established by this diagnosis.
Missing pre-registration MQTT credentials are not by themselves the proven cause; the original flow receives them after successful registration.
No identity cloning, model changes, forced EEPROM omission or local cloud-state changes were attempted.
VPN access and cloud-dependent features such as Teleport were not tested.
